title: Grand Theft Auto 2/Power-ups
text:
Power-ups are placed throughout each area or district, and they can be activated by running or driving over their spinning icons. They can also be created by crushing vehicles.

When picked up, the power-up name is shown briefly in red text in the top center of the screen, and it's announced by a voice.

Health and Armor can spawn again after 15 seconds during play, but other power-ups won't until you quit and resume saved status.

__TOC__

Power-ups

The following power-ups have a time limit, during which an icon appears in the top right corner, left of any Armor and  beneath Score, Health and any weapon and its ammo, and they aren't saved:

Crusher
Power-ups can be created by driving vehicles to a crusher which has a conveyor belt, exiting to let the vehicle be picked up by the crane and crushed, then collecting any power-up from the conveyor belt nearby.
